7 Brew Fruit Roll-Up Lemonade: Price & Calories

A medium Fruit Roll-Up Lemonade is about $3.50, with 270 calories, 0 mg of caffeine and 66 g of sugar. Every number here comes from 7 Brew's own published nutrition guide, broken out by size and preparation.

Fruit Roll-Up Lemonade allergens

7 Brew's published allergen guide lists no declared allergens for the standard Fruit Roll-Up Lemonade. Adding a milk, syrup or topping changes this, and every drink is made on shared equipment, so cross-contact is possible.

If you are ordering around an allergy, check the full allergen and dietary guide and confirm at the window.

How to order a Fruit Roll-Up Lemonade

Ask for it by name — it is on the standard board at every 7 Brew, so no special script is needed. Say the size first, then the drink: "Can I get a medium Fruit Roll-Up Lemonade?"

Worth knowing before you order: the base is customisable. You can swap milk, ask for sugar-free syrups, change the sweetness level, or have most drinks made iced, hot or blended as a frozen chiller where the menu allows. Ordering through the app earns 100 rewards points either way.

Make a Fruit Roll-Up Lemonade at Home

The whole game here is the ratio. Strawberry does the talking, lavender whispers. Pour them equal and you get soap. Pour them 4-to-1 and you get the drink.

For one tall glass (16 oz)

  • 1 cup lemonade (your batch or a good bottled one)
  • 1 tablespoon strawberry syrup
  • 1 teaspoon lavender syrup. Start there. Seriously.
  • 1 to 1 1/2 cups ice, crushed or nugget if you have it
  1. Stir both syrups into the cold lemonade first.
  2. Fill the cup with ice, pour the lemonade over, stir once more.
  3. Taste. Want more lavender? Add it a half teaspoon at a time. There is no going back the other way.

Green tea version: swap half the lemonade for chilled green tea, exactly like the stand's featured build. Bigger batch: multiply by six in a pitcher for the version a crowd drains before the ice melts.

7 Brew Fruit Roll-Up Lemonade FAQ

How many calories are in a 7 Brew Fruit Roll-Up Lemonade?

A medium iced Fruit Roll-Up Lemonade has 270 calories. A small has 200 and a large 400, according to 7 Brew's nutrition guide.

How much caffeine is in a 7 Brew Fruit Roll-Up Lemonade?

0 mg in the lemonade itself. The green tea version is a different story, covered in the questions below.

How much does a 7 Brew Fruit Roll-Up Lemonade cost?

Roughly $2.75 for a small, $3.50 for a medium and $4.25 for a large. Prices are our estimates and vary by stand — every 7 Brew is independently owned.

How much sugar is in a 7 Brew Fruit Roll-Up Lemonade?

66 g in a medium.

Does Fruit Roll-Up Lemonade actually taste like the candy?

Close, not exact, and that is the honest consensus. There is no candy in the cup. The strawberry brings the sweet fruit-snack hit first, the lemonade cuts in tart, and the lavender lands soft and floral at the end. Fans call it candy, but liquid. Reviewers land in the same place: nostalgic and candy-like, not a replica of unrolling the real thing. If you want it sweeter and closer to the snack, order it extra sweet. If the floral note worries you, read the lavender question below before you judge.

What is the Fruit Roll-Up Green Tea Lemonade, and how much caffeine does it have?

It was an official featured drink in May 2026: the same strawberry and lavender, built on half green tea and half lemonade, an Arnold Palmer with a twist. It is still orderable, because every part of it still exists. Now the honest part: 7 Brew never put it in the nutrition guide, so there are NO official calories or caffeine figures for it. Third-party sites estimate around 41 mg of caffeine for a medium, and that word estimate is doing real work. Any page printing exact numbers for this drink is guessing. What is certain is that it has some caffeine from the tea half, unlike the plain lemonade's zero.

Why is there no sugar-free Fruit Roll-Up Lemonade?

Two walls. First, the lemonade base is sweetened, so no lemonade starts at zero. Second, and this is the specific one: strawberry exists as a sugar-free flavor at 7 Brew, but lavender does not. Half the drink's identity has no sugar-free version to swap in. So the guide publishes no sugar-free Fruit Roll-Up, and one cannot really be built. Treat the guide that claims sugar-free syrup drops this drink under 50 calories as fiction. Half sweet or quarter sweet is the real lever, and the tart base carries it well. The drinks that do come sugar-free, all 43 of them, are compared on our sugar-free page.

How strong is the lavender? Will it taste like soap?

It is a finish, not a takeover, in the standard build. Strawberry leads and lavender trails. The soap risk is real only when the balance breaks, which is why home copycats that pour the two syrups in equal parts keep disappointing people. If you are lavender-nervous, order it light lavender the first time. Most people who do that end up at the regular build by the second visit.

Why do the calorie ranges online not match this page?

Mostly preparation mixing. The top experience guide tops its large at 380 calories, but the official iced large is 400, and its ranges leave out the frozen chiller entirely, where a large runs 830. Another page headlines 150 to 830 for the drink, which is a kids iced at one end and a large chiller at the other, with neither labeled. The table above separates iced and chiller by size, from the official guide. When a number has no preparation attached, it is not a number yet.
